text.p: A total of 1.13 million shares in Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom changed hands in electronic trading on Wednesday at an average 2,757 roubles ($0.49) a share, up from 2,601 roubles at the previous session on January 31, the Federal Securities Corporation (FFK) said.
Full details of the trading session:
Gazprom is one of Russia's biggest companies by market capitalisation but its 23.6 billion shares are highly illiquid because of company restrictions on selling them.
The company has organised regular auctions and electronic trading sessions to create an orderly market in its paper.
Gazprom was $0.455 at 1045 GMT on Wednesday on the Russian Trading System, down from $0.477 on Tuesday.
Its American Depositary Shares were $19.80 after $19.45. One ADS is equivalent to 10 ordinary shares.
The next electronic trading sessions will be held on February 7, 12 and 14.
